posts.title: Smallest Possible Things That Keep You Going
posts.description: There’s an old Russian story about a woman at the end of the Romantic Age. She went to a high bluff overlooking, I can’t remember if it was a raging river or a vast ocean, and threw herself off. And it was because of the drama. And the wholeness. And the grandeur.
